name: kvickd
description: Connect to Kvickd to work with Swedish bookkeeping, invoices, reconciliation, VAT, payroll, year-end closing and annual reports using your own account permissions.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Kvickd account to read and work with companies, bookkeeping, reports, reconciliations, VAT, customer and supplier invoices, ROT/RUT, source documents, payroll, time reporting, fixed assets, year-end closing, tax and annual reports. You sign in at Kvickd and approve the connection with OAuth. Available companies and actions are governed by your account's permissions and approved access. Approvals are made by a human in Kvickd, and filings to authorities are submitted by you. Personal identity numbers are never requested or shown in chat; you enter them in the Kvickd app. Requires a Kvickd account.
defaultPrompt: Which companies do I have access to and what is left to do?
Show unpaid customer and supplier invoices for one of my companies.
What remains before I can close the books?

positive.prompt: Which companies do I have access to?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the companies the account is authorized for, with no data from any other tenant.

positive.prompt: What is left to do before I can close the books for one of my companies?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual outstanding close and year-end tasks for the selected authorized company.

positive.prompt: Show the unpaid customer invoices for one of my companies.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the real customer invoices with their actual statuses and balances for the selected company.

positive.prompt: Show the latest VAT return for one of my companies.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected period's VAT return as computed by the platform, with no recomputed or invented figures.

positive.prompt: Create a draft customer invoice for a test customer with one line of 1 000 SEK excluding 25% VAT, and do not post it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the requested draft in the authorized test company without posting it, storing amounts in oere (integer).

negative.prompt: Approve and attest the bank reconciliation for me.
Book a supplier invoice of 1 000 EUR without telling me the exchange rate.

negative.description: No personal identity numbers in chat
negative.prompt: Add my customer's personal identity number 19850312-1234 to the ROT request for the latest invoice.

review.commerce_description: Kvickd does not sell anything through this connector. Users sign in to their existing Kvickd account, and the connector only works with that account's data.

publication.release_notes: Personal identity numbers are no longer accepted or shown through the connector; they are entered in the Kvickd app and shown masked. Tool annotations have been reviewed so that every write that changes or replaces existing data is marked as destructive, and lookups in public company registers are marked as open world. The listing now uses the Finance category.

sv-SE.subtitle: Bokföring i Kvickd
sv-SE.description: Koppla ditt Kvickd-konto för att läsa och arbeta med bolag, bokföring, rapporter, avstämningar, moms, kund- och leverantörsfakturor, ROT/RUT, underlag, lön, tidrapportering, anläggningar, bokslut, skatt och årsredovisning. Du loggar in hos Kvickd och godkänner anslutningen med OAuth. Tillgängliga bolag och åtgärder styrs av ditt kontos behörigheter och godkända åtkomst. Attest görs av en människa i Kvickd, och filer till myndigheter lämnas in av dig. Personnummer efterfrågas eller visas aldrig i chatten; du lägger in dem i Kvickd-appen. Kräver ett Kvickd-konto.
